value.title: La Tigrenetta
value.synopsis: The origin of Tiger is told as a flashback. As the legend goes, Tiger used to be a mermaid. One day the evil ruler of the sea, Bubble Grandpa, demanded a hamburger and picked Tiger to retrieve it. He used his magic sea powers to give Tiger legs and send her ashore. But Tiger grew to love the land, and with the help of her new friend, Uncle Grandpa, defeated the evil sea ruler and got to keep her legs.

value.title: La pallina rossa
value.synopsis: Mister Gus fixes the ballroom and warns Uncle Grandpa and Pizza Steve.

value.title: In biblioteca
value.synopsis: Uncle Grandpa prende sempre in prestito dalla biblioteca comunale il suo libro preferito, ma ogni volta si dimentica di riconsegnarlo.

value.title: Uncle Pasqua
value.synopsis: When the Easter Bunny is unable to fulfill his duties, Uncle Grandpa steps in to help with egg-delivery.

value.title: Re Gus e la spada nel sandwich
value.synopsis: Things get out of hand when Mr. Gus fulfills a timeless legend and is deemed king of the food court.

value.title: Il film di Uncle Grandpa
value.synopsis: The gang attends the premiere of "Majestico and Uncle Grandpa Boy", a movie about a little girl who wants to become a super hero.

value.title: Gioca con me
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve ha comprato una nuovissima game station, ma Uncle Grandpa preferisce giocare col semplice e un po' obsoleto gioco di Mr. Gus.

value.title: Missione spaziale
value.synopsis: In the year 3021, the gang's intergalactic mission goes awry when a strange alien creature infiltrates their ship.

value.title: Un weekend da relax
value.synopsis: La rilassante vacanza di un weekend di Uncle Grandpa diventa presto un incubo spaventoso per Pizza Steve.

value.title: La terra delle ombre perdute
value.synopsis: When pieces of their shadows are stolen by a shadow demon, Uncle Grandpa and the gang must travel to the Land of Lost Shadows in order to retrieve them.

value.title: Pizza Eve
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve mente ad Uncle Grandpa e a Mr. Gus sulla bellezza della sua fidanzata, tanto che gli amici non vedono l'ora di vederla.

value.title: Il ritorno di Aunt Grandma
value.synopsis: Uncle Grandpa's gang joins Aunt Grandma in helping children after seeing a fake hate video of them.

value.title: Messy Bessy
value.synopsis: Seth has to clean his room to avoid Messy Bessy's wrath.

value.title: I ricordi di Pizza Steve
value.synopsis: Quando un nuovo materasso cancella la memoria di Pizza Steve, Uncle Grandpa e Mr. Gus devono trovare il modo per farla ritornare.

value.title: Ancora altri corti
value.synopsis: Weird Man apprehends a criminal; Belly Bag finds a cat stuck in the RV tree; Uncle Grandpa hosts a space exploration program.

value.title: Emergenza pulci
value.synopsis: The gang helps Charlie Burgers get rid of his fleas.

value.title: I malvagi occhiali da sole
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve rompe i suoi occhiali da sole così ne prende in prestito un paio da Uncle Grandpa, ma con questi inizierà a vedere cose strane.

value.title: La vendetta delle verdure
value.synopsis: In order to rescue Uncle Grandpa and the others from a gang of evil vegetables, a young boy must learn to eat his spinach.

value.title: Fra le nuvole
value.synopsis: Uncle Grandpa helps a boy get his head out of the clouds and focused on his history test.

value.title: Una gita in Irlanda
value.synopsis: On a St. Patrick's Day trip to Ireland, Uncle Grandpa and the gang cross paths with a sneaky leprechaun.

value.title: Ragazzi alla moda
value.synopsis: Uncle Grandpa helps a boy who wants to be a fashion designer.
